question: If x : y = 5 : 2, then what is (8x - 9y) : (14x - 13y)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let x = 5 and y = 2

Then, (8 x 5 - 9 x 2) : (14 x 5 - 13 x 2)

⇒ 22 : 44 = 1 : 2

 ∴ Required ratio is 1 : 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

x : y = 5 : 2

**Calculation:**

Let x = 5a

and y = 2a

Then,

⇒ (8 x 5a - 9 x 2a) : (14 x 5a - 13 x 2a)

⇒ (40a - 18a) : (70a - 26a)

⇒ 22a : 44a

⇒ 1:2

**∴ Required ratio is 1 : 2.**
